skills: Understand the Claude API's available endpoints, authentication headers, client SDKs, pagination, rate limits, and cloud platform access options.
Access experimental features before they become part of the standard API with the anthropic-beta header or the SDK's betas parameter.
Understand the HTTP status codes, error response shape, and request IDs the Claude API returns, and handle errors with the SDK's typed exceptions.
IAM action reference for controlling access to Claude Platform on AWS through AWS policies.
Look up Google Cloud IAM permissions, predefined roles, and audit log types for Claude Models on Google Cloud (Anthropic managed).

Anthropic services use fixed IP addresses for both inbound and outbound connections. You can use these addresses to configure your firewall rules for secure access to the Claude API and Claude Console. These addresses will not change without notice.
"Upgrade a Claude API integration from API version 2023-06-01 to 2026-10-21: the SDK version to install and the code changes to make."
To mitigate misuse and manage capacity on the API, limits are in place on how much an organization can use the Claude API.
Different tiers of service allow you to balance availability, performance, and predictable costs based on your application's needs.
"Here are the countries, regions, and territories Anthropic can support access from:"
"When making API requests, you must send an anthropic-version request header. For example, anthropic-version: 2026-10-21. If you are using the client SDK, it sets this header for you."
Start a Claude Code routine session on demand by sending an authenticated POST request.
